_help: Windows: previews Windows .ico files with a private build of netpbm's ico2png, which extracts the largest size in the icon as PNG — not a publicly-downloadable tool, so replace <ICO2PNG_PATH> with wherever your own equivalent lives (or write your own: any command that turns an .ico into a PNG works). See ico-preview.linux-macos.json for an icotool-based alternative on Linux (untested here, built from its documented CLI rather than run). Waydir ignores every key starting with "_".
